task_completion.description: Open the human_pre_miRNAs.fasta file in UGENE
task_completion.visual_evidence: UGENE interface showing the sequences hsa-let-7a-1, hsa-mir-155, and hsa-mir-21 loaded in the project view or sequence viewer.

task_completion.description: Run RNA secondary structure prediction (MFE) for all three miRNAs
task_completion.visual_evidence: The RNA secondary structure prediction dialog or the appearance of secondary structure annotations (dot-bracket or visual loops) on the sequences in UGENE.

task_completion.description: Export the annotated sequences as a single GenBank file to the specified path
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Export as GenBank' dialog showing the output path ~/UGENE_Data/rna/results/mirna_structures.gb and the selection of all three sequences.

task_completion.description: Create a text report with name, MFE value, and dot-bracket notation
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or file viewer showing mfe_report.txt containing the names (let-7a-1, miR-155, miR-21), their respective MFE values (negative numbers), and dot-bracket strings.

task_completion.description: Confirm both output files exist in the results directory
task_completion.visual_evidence: A file manager or terminal window showing both mirna_structures.gb and mfe_report.txt in the ~/UGENE_Data/rna/results/ folder.

integrity.description: The agent used the UGENE GUI for structure prediction and export
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the UGENE application window, menus, and RNA folding dialogs rather than just terminal commands.

integrity.description: MFE values and structures were generated by the software, not hardcoded
integrity.visual_evidence: The presence of the UGENE 'RNA Secondary Structure Prediction' progress bar or results panel.

integrity.description: The agent processed all three specific sequences mentioned in the task
integrity.visual_evidence: The project tree or sequence viewer lists hsa-let-7a-1 (80bp), hsa-mir-155 (64bp), and hsa-mir-21 (72bp).

privileged_info_for_vlm: The input file contains three sequences with specific lengths: hsa-let-7a-1 (80 bp), hsa-mir-155 (64 bp), and hsa-mir-21 (72 bp). The final outputs must be located at ~/UGENE_Data/rna/results/mirna_structures.gb and ~/UGENE_Data/rna/results/mfe_report.txt. The report must contain the MFE value and dot-bracket notation for all three miRNAs.
